system.description:
Once per turn, a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage takes 1d6 necrotic damage for each rank it has, when it makes a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw.

A creature with Crimson Hemorrhage that takes Unarmed or Weapon damage from a hostile creature, heals the attacking creatures hit points by 2.

At the end of a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage’s turn, if it have ranks of Bleed, it lose those ranks of Bleed and gain an equal number of ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage. This does not occur if it have 5 ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage.
system.summary: 1d6 necrotic per rank when it makes a Str, Dex or Con save (once per turn); hostile unarmed or weapon damage heals the attacker 2.

rules.text: Once per turn, when it makes a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution save, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage per rank. A hostile creature that deals it unarmed or weapon damage regains 2 hit points. At the end of its turn its ranks of Bleed become ranks of this (not at 5 ranks).
